## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Old Mr. Bentley is a minister characterized by his complete lack of imagination. Habitually drunk or seeking alcohol, his ability to pray eloquently remarkably improves the more intoxicated he becomes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P35](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0035)_

## History

Bentley arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as a widower and remained one throughout his tenure. He served as the pastor of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) church for eighteen years, though [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) found him to be lacking in imagination. He was eventually succeeded in his role as minister by Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI.
